bagPolicy.summary: One small handbag per person is allowed, no larger than A4. Backpacks and larger bags are not permitted inside.
allowed: One small handbag up to A4
bagPolicy.note: Limited bag storage is in a portacabin in the Official Blue Car Park on the Etihad Campus: £5 for coats, large umbrellas and professional cameras, £10 for bags up to rucksack size, £15 for anything larger. Contact the venue in advance to bring otherwise banned items for medical reasons. Event pages may list extra rules.

parking.note: Co-op Live encourages visitors to use public transport options such as walking, cycling, or trams to reduce carbon emissions. There is no specific mention of parking options or pricing on the page.

rideshare.note: Use the designated pickup and drop-off area on Edwin Road, M11 3ER.

concessions.note: Co-op Live offers a diverse selection of 32 food and drink concessions, including buzzing bars, premium restaurants, vibrant lounges, and exclusive club spaces. The venue is cashless, accepting only contactless or card payments.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking is available at Co-op Live for £25, and must be reserved in advance.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Co-op Live's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Co-op Live. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Co-op Live. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
